name: code
description: Code is a typography component used for inline and block code, set in a monospaced typeface.

emphasis.description: Emphasis of the text run: emphasized is italic, strong is bolder, and the two combine. Unset is the regular style.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the component: the block that holds the text run.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Text run styled by the typography token set.

anatomyReview.notes: No Figma component; the style exists only as text styles (Figma), a font macro value (React Spectrum) and one Typography stylesheet (SWC). The text part holds the type style; margins are properties of it. The container part is the root the recipe draws it in. Owner decision D1 (2026-11-19): keep five components.
